comment: TRIG IN and SYNC IN are edge-detected on (int)getVoltage(), not on a Schmitt trigger, so the threshold is one whole volt in either direction and a negative swing past -1V is an edge as much as a positive one past +1V. The negative field is left off those two ports because none of ignored, subtracts or swings describes it. SH OUT is written only inside the if(samp) branch, so it holds its last value indefinitely when nothing is patched to GATE IN or TRIG IN. The README's 0.3Hz to 30Hz clock range, the 5ms trigger length and the 20V peak-to-peak white noise are all literals in the code. The README calls the pink filter a -3dB per octave approximation; that figure is not a constant anywhere in the source, so it is not quoted in the lines.
